fix_commit_message: Fix silent zero-gradient bug in apply_svd_to_in_proj path
justification: P8A (run 9lmvb5b4) trained 2026-04-24 21:41 UTC -> 23:48 UTC, ending ~43.4 hours BEFORE the in_proj-SVD gradient bug was fixed in commit 2feea58 (2026-04-26 19:13 UTC). The P8A retro itself (docs/packet_retrospectives/packets/P8A.md, line 29 + line 108) and memory project_in_proj_svd_gradient_bug.md both explicitly name P8A's run 9lmvb5b4 as among the affected pre-fix runs ('Every P8A run had apply_svd_to_in_proj: true but the q/k/v residuals received zero classification gradient until the 2026-04-26 fix'). The training plan log (april-26-training-master-plan-v2.LOG.md, line 214) confirms the FT chain inventory: 'P8A (9lmvb5b4/step5000, ~5k broken-bug steps)'. The yaml R13_RLP8_01_unfreeze_clip_codec.yaml had apply_svd_to_in_proj=true active during training, so the q/k/v SVD residuals received zero classification-task gradient throughout P8A's 5k steps and were only nudged by the regularizer.
implication_for_ft_from_p8a: Pre-fix => the in_proj-SVD lever (3M params per attention block x 12 blocks ~= 36M params of q/k/v residuals) was a no-op throughout P8A's training. A fresh FT-from-P8A on the post-fix (>=2feea58) codepath would for the first time route real classification gradient through these residuals, opening unmeasured headroom. This is the structural argument the external advisor (NEXT_STEPS_PLAN_2026-05-06.md sec 6.5) flags for picking P8A as the FT base for PE_PAIR_RANK_DRO. The 'free experiment' framing holds: any post-fix retraining starts from a checkpoint whose in_proj-SVD residuals are essentially still at SVD-init (only regularizer-nudged), and the lever set is materially larger than during P8A's original 5k steps.
uncertainty_notes: Timestamps for P8A start/end come from analysis/overnight_packet7_packet8_summary_2026-04-25.md line 67 and the P8A packet retro (line 29). They are wall-clock retros, not gcloud ai custom-jobs describe outputs - precision is +/- 1 minute. The 5k checkpoint was step 5000 of a 10k schedule (early-stopped at the value_composite peak), so all 5000 training steps occurred within the 21:41 -> 23:48 UTC window, all 43+ hours before the fix. No part of P8A overlapped the fix commit. Confidence is HIGH because: (a) the wiki retro explicitly labels P8A as pre-fix on the in_proj-SVD gradient bug, (b) the master plan log inventories P8A as '~5k broken-bug steps', (c) the date arithmetic is unambiguous (>40h gap), (d) the GCS checkpoint filename embeds 20260424 confirming the training-day, (e) the fix commit's stated landing date in memory (2026-04-26) matches the git log timestamp exactly. There is no plausible scenario where P8A is post-fix.
